claims.statement: The Agent Factory is implemented in factory.py, which constructs compiled LangGraph state machines for agentic loops that orchestrate model invocation, tool execution, and middleware composition.
Agent middleware system is implemented in the middleware directory, providing pluggable hooks for injecting logic at model, tool, and lifecycle boundaries.

BaseChatModel abstract base class and unified provider interface are implemented in langchain_core/language_models/chat_models.py, handling streaming, batching, token counting, and structured output marshaling.

Message types (AIMessage, HumanMessage, SystemMessage, ToolMessage) and content blocks are defined in langchain_core/messages/, providing unified message representation across all provider integrations.

The Runnable protocol is the foundational abstraction for composable units, implemented in langchain_core/runnables/base.py, defining invoke(), stream(), batch(), and async variants, with composition operators for piping, branching, fallback, and retry.

BaseTool abstraction and tool conversion utilities are implemented in langchain_core/tools/, supporting sync/async invocation, schema generation from docstrings and Pydantic models, and structured argument parsing.
Prompt templates are implemented in langchain_core/prompts/, including chat prompts, few-shot examples, image prompts, and structured prompt abstractions.
Callback manager infrastructure for instrumentation and LangSmith integration is implemented in langchain_core/callbacks/, providing base handlers and streaming output callbacks.
The init_chat_model() factory function for dynamic model discovery and instantiation by provider:model identifier is implemented in langchain/chat_models/base.py.
Provider-specific implementations such as ChatOpenAI are located in libs/partners/<provider>/ directories, each implementing core abstractions and released independently.
LLM behavior and capability profiles are implemented in libs/model-profiles/langchain_model_profiles/, providing metadata about model capabilities and configuration.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) adapter, tools, and elicitation are implemented in langchain/mcp/, providing MCP-based model integrations.
Schema definition and response marshaling for typed agent outputs is implemented in langchain/agents/structured_output.py.
Tests are organized as unit_tests/ and integration_tests/ within each package (core, langchain_v1, partners), with shared test contracts in libs/standard-tests/.

Configuration files include pyproject.toml in each package for dependencies and metadata, pre-commit configuration at repo root for git hooks, and Makefile in libs/ for multi-package build coordination.

LangChain uses a three-layer architecture: langchain-core (v1.6.9) for base abstractions, langchain (v1.4.4) for orchestration and agents, and partners for provider-specific implementations, enabling model interoperability and independent release cycles.
